sourceText: User selected the next step for Research M0: actually execute M0 rather than continue writing docs, select E1/E2 model family and dated snapshots, register runner/host/promptDigest/toolSurfaceDigest, smoke E2 harness tool-surface equivalence, check A2prime budget-lock, check analysis contrasts ③ vs ⑥, ① vs ②, ③ vs ④, and still not run large-scale Phase 1.
